description:
About Neural Grader

Neural Grader builds AI-powered industrial scanners for the wood industry, combining cameras, lasers, GPU servers, networking and real-time software to detect wood defects and improve grading and yield optimization.

We are looking for an Infrastructure & Systems Engineer to own the infrastructure behind our scanners: servers, cameras, networking, racks, monitoring, observability, remote access, deployment, backups, security and reliability.

This is not an MLOps, PLC automation or electrical installation role. It is a hands-on infrastructure role focused on infrastructure reliability, monitoring, operations and automation.

Core Mission

The mission is to keep Neural Grader scanner systems running from a hardware and infrastructure point of view, predict failure points, and prevent them before production is affected.

This person will own monitoring, alerting and observability for production infrastructure, including proactive detection of failures, performance degradation, and hardware or network anomalies.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and maintain Linux-based scanner infrastructure: servers, GPU machines, networking, storage, backups and remote access.
  • Keep production scanner systems running reliably, with strong focus on monitoring, troubleshooting, prevention and incident response.
  • Build and own monitoring, logging, alerting and observability for production infrastructure.
  • Detect, investigate and prevent hardware, server, camera, storage, network and performance issues before they affect production.
  • Participate in an on-call / incident-response rotation for production scanner infrastructure.
  • Work with industrial cameras, high-bandwidth image acquisition, 10G/100G networking, VLANs, PTP synchronization and rack-mounted hardware.
  • Deploy and maintain applications, databases, virtualization services and supporting infrastructure.
  • Automate repetitive work using scripting, Docker, Ansible, Python, K3s or similar tools.
  • Manage secure remote access, VPNs, firewalls, certificates, credentials and access control.
  • Write clear documentation, runbooks, troubleshooting guides and setup procedures.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or coding assistants to speed up scripting, troubleshooting and documentation.
  • Work closely with software, research, hardware, automation and support teams.

What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure, systems engineering, DevOps, Linux administration or networking.
  • Strong Linux and networking knowledge.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, alerting and troubleshooting tools.
  • Experience with Docker, application deployment, databases and virtualization services.
  • Scripting skills, for example Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Ansible or similar automation tools.
  • Good understanding of security, remote access and backup/recovery practices.
  • Comfortable with on-call responsibilities and production incident response.
  • Very organized, structured and documentation-oriented.
  • Fluent English.
  • University degree preferred, but strong practical experience can replace it.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with ML infrastructure, real-time image processing, GPU servers or NVIDIA systems.
  • Experience with industrial cameras, GigE Vision, PTP synchronization or high-bandwidth acquisition.
  • Cloud infrastructure experience or exposure to industrial environments.

Work Model:

  • Bucharest-based; hybrid: around 1 day per week in the office.
  • No regular client-site travel expected.
  • Reports to the Head of Infrastructure and Systems.

Why Join Us

You will help build the infrastructure foundation for real industrial AI scanners operating in demanding production environments. Your work will directly improve the reliability, scalability and maintainability of Neural Grader systems.
